description: List proposals/candidates for an OpenTrain job with statuses, bids, AI interview scores, resume match scores, and the application-stage screening standing (`screening` + `screeningRead`; sort: "screening_score" returns one ranked page with `ranking`/`hasMore`) — the primary tool for reviewing and ranking who to hire. Requires proposals:read scope. Use opentrain_get_proposal for one candidate in depth, then opentrain_hire_proposal to hire.

jobId.description: OpenTrain job id to list proposals for.

limit.description: Maximum proposals to return. Defaults to 25.

sort.description: recent (default; newest first, cursor-pageable) or screening_score: rank by the application-stage screening course score (highest first, ungraded last; one ranked page bounded by limit — no cursor). Each proposal carries a screening block with status, percentage, passed, and whether the applicant took the current course version.

status.description: Optional proposal status filter such as UNREVIEWED, SHORTLISTED, HIRED, or DECLINED.

name: opentrain_list_proposals
